q: A resistor is an electrical device which is used to ____ the electric current flowing in a circuit.
e: Current is charge per second. Conventional current is opposite to electron drift. A resistor is an electrical device which is used to control the electric current flowing in a circuit.

q: It is made of a substance having ____.
e: It is made of a substance having resistance. Resistance is what this statement is using.

q: There are two types of resistors: fixed resistors and ____.
e: There are two types of resistors: fixed resistors and variable resistors. Variable resistors is what this statement is using.

q: A ____ (variable resistor) and its symbol are shown in circuit diagrams to indicate adjustable resistance.
e: Resistance is V/I. A larger resistance gives a smaller current for the same voltage. A rheostat (variable resistor) and its symbol are shown in circuit diagrams to indicate adjustable resistance.
